findings.fixHint: Add a stable `data-composition-id` to the entry composition wrapper.
Set numeric `data-width` and `data-height` on the entry composition root.

findings.message: Timeline registered as "main" but no element has data-composition-id="main". The runtime cannot auto-nest this timeline.
findings.fixHint: Change window.__timelines["main"] to match the data-composition-id attribute, or vice versa.

findings.message: GSAP tween uses `repeat: -1` (infinite) without a finite composition `data-duration`. The timeline can report an unbounded duration and make render planning fail.
findings.fixHint: Add a finite composition `data-duration`, or replace `repeat: -1` with `repeat: Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalDuration / singleCycleDuration) - 1)`.

findings.message: <div id="scene-hook"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene-hook"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
